summary: RAG-Token: same answer on 488 of 488 held-out questions, the five retrieval log-probabilities within 8.6e-06 (documents whose scores tie exactly, such as an author's two book documents, can come back in either order), answer log-probability within 6.3e-06; RAG-Sequence: same answer on 488 of 488 held-out questions, the five retrieval log-probabilities within 6.6e-06 (documents whose scores tie exactly, such as an author's two book documents, can come back in either order), answer log-probability within 5.5e-06
